name: PR/SET domain 1
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PRDM1 encodes PR domain zinc finger protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription repressor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
